## Goal

Give every agent one accurate, short set of instructions and docs derived from the real code.

## Context

AGENTS.md held only the Next.js block, CLAUDE.md only imported it, README described step 1 and Vercel.

## Scope

- AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, README.md status section, docs/SPEC, DESIGN, ARCHITECTURE, DATABASE, SECURITY, TESTING, DEPLOYMENT, TASKS, STATUS, DECISIONS, WORKFLOW, LAUNCH-CHECKLIST.
- Issue seed files.

## Out of scope

- Code changes.
- Fixing the env.ts / env.public.ts comment contradiction (follow-up in SC-003).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Docs name only routes, tables, scripts and env vars that exist (Codex spot-checks 10 claims).
- [ ] No rule in CLAUDE.md contradicts AGENTS.md.
- [ ] Next.js agent block in AGENTS.md preserved verbatim.

## Required tests

- `pnpm format:check` passes on the changed files.
- Codex review of factual claims.

## Dependencies

- SC-001

## Priority

P1 · Phase A

Cowork (PM)
